items.prompt: A stored sequence is retried with different delta content. What should this own journal do?

options.text: Treat it as an exact duplicate
Raise a conflict without committing a change
options.why: Identity and normalized content must agree.

options.text: Append both under the same primary key silently
Advance the cursor and omit both

items.explanation: Sequence identity is source-bound by this one-namespace private model; conflicts are not no-ops.
